set.body: Lower arbitrary affine volume routes by composing coordinate pullbacks before constructing one target-from-root sampling operator. Reuse the image morphism execution-plan kernel where appropriate without exposing repeated resampling. Acceptance: a chain of affine views compiles to one sampling operator; direct-composite and routed results agree against independent coordinate fixtures; a regression fixture distinguishes the result from sequential double interpolation; ROI and boundary policies survive fusion; operator provenance records the original route and fused execution.
set.title: Spatial affine fusion: one root sampling step for chained volume transforms
